title: Account Executive
description:
About Nira Energy

  • Nira's mission is to help convert the US power grid to be 100% fossil-free.
  • We are profitable!
  • Nira is a software platform that helps renewable energy developers find the cheapest points on the grid to connect.
  • We focus on estimating the cost to interconnect with the electrical grid (aka the Interconnection Process). Depending on where developers connect, they may be on the hook to pay millions of dollars to upgrade power lines, substations etc.

About The Role

As an Account Executive at Nira, you’ll play a critical role in growing our customer base of renewable energy Developers/IPPs. Your focus will be new sales —proactively identifying, engaging, and converting high-potential prospects into long-term customers.

You’ll become an expert in interconnection, positioning Nira as a strategic advantage for developers looking to build profitable projects. This role is ideal for someone who likes understanding and solving complex customer problems, is deeply curious about the grid, and is intent on shaping the future of clean energy.

What You'll Do

  • Drive new business from renewable energy developers to achieve a $2M annual quota.
  • Own the full sales cycle—prospect, qualify, demo, negotiate, and close.
  • Research and target renewable energy developers using a strategic and data-driven approach
  • Engage with Transmission, Interconnection, and Development teams to understand their pain points
  • Educate prospects on how Nira can de-risk and accelerate their project development
  • Partner with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Data) to relay customer insights and refine messaging
  • Track pipeline activity and maintain accurate forecasts in the CRM
  • Build trust along with a strong pipeline of deals through outbounds, industry events, and relationships.
  • Become a student of interconnection and transmission planning — able to speak credibly with technical buyers.
  • Partner closely with product and customer success to ensure smooth onboarding and long-term adoption.
  • Work with the sales leadership team to refine our sales playbook.

About You

  • 2–7 years of experience in SaaS or energy sales (startup experience a plus).
    • Either: (a) Background in renewable development or interconnection, OR (b) proven ability to sell into a technical market without prior domain experience.
  • You’re energized by outbound prospecting and breaking into new accounts
  • You have (or are excited to develop) a strong understanding of transmission and grid interconnection
  • You’re a clear, persuasive communicator who can navigate technical conversations with confidence
  • You’re self-motivated, organized, and thrive in fast-moving environments
  • You care deeply about accelerating the energy transition and making a real impact
  • A track record of beating quota, ideally closing $500k–$2M+ ARR per year.
  • Hustle + grit: you create opportunities.
  • Desire to work at a startup — resourceful, adaptable, and coachable.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and relationship-building skills.

What We Offer

  • $150,000-$200,000 base salary
  • Uncapped commission
  • Equity in a fast-growing climate tech startup
  • Remote-first culture with a growing presence in NYC
  • Health, dental, vision, and 401k.

title: Account Executive & Growth - Utilities
description:
About Nira Energy

  • Nira's mission is to help convert the US power grid to be 100% fossil-free.
  • We are profitable!
  • Nira is a software platform that helps renewable energy developers find the cheapest points on the grid to connect.
  • We focus on estimating the cost to interconnect with the electrical grid (aka the Interconnection Process). Depending on where developers connect, they may be on the hook to pay millions of dollars to upgrade power lines, substations etc.

About The Role

As an Account Executive & Growth, Utilities at Nira, you will drive both new business and account expansion within the utility sector. You will own the full sales cycle—from identifying high-potential prospects and engaging them, to presenting Nira’s value, closing deals, and expanding revenue with existing customers. You’ll become a subject-matter expert in transmission planning, positioning Nira as a strategic advantage for utilities aiming to improve their transmission planning processes and studies.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex customer problems, is deeply curious about the grid, and is passionate about shaping the future of energy transition.

What You'll Do

  • Prospect and engage utility organizations to initiate discussions about how Nira can benefit their transmission planning and grid analysis workflows.
  • Lead conversations with utility stakeholders to uncover business needs, present Nira solutions, and define meaningful next steps to maintain momentum.
  • Employ effective business development tactics to shorten long sales cycles.
  • Develop and present measurable business cases and ROI scenarios for utility partners.
  • Build and manage multi-stakeholder relationships with utility leaders across departments (e.g., Transmission Planning, IT, Legal, Commercial).
  • Develop and validate proof-of-concept (POC) programs to demonstrate Nira automation capabilities to utility leaders.
  • Create tailored solutions based on customer needs and facilitate complex discussions with technical and non-technical buyers.
  • Address objections and demonstrate Nira’s value through compelling use cases and demonstrations.
  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle: prospect, qualify, demo, negotiate, and close.
  • Develop clear proposals and statements of work (SOWs) that articulate objectives, functionality, KPIs, and next steps.
  • Translate POCs into scalable product subscriptions with utility teams.
  • Monitor user feedback and maintain a pulse on client satisfaction to support retention and expansion.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Transmission Planners, Software Engineers, and Product) to align on customer needs and product direction.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, track pipeline, and forecast with discipline.
  • Communicate credibly with technical and non-technical buyers alike.
  • Stay informed on transmission planning regulations and market structures across US jurisdictions.

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in energy or utility business development; startup experience is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of utility business dynamics and, ideally, transmission planning frameworks.
  • You love building relationships, own your work, and are motivated by outbound prospecting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you can navigate technical discussions with confidence.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and thrives in fast-moving environments.
  • Passionate about accelerating the energy transition and delivering measurable impact.
  • Persistent, resourceful, and coachable; you thrive with ambiguity and can adapt quickly.
  • Comfortable engaging with executive and technical stakeholders, including cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to articulate value in terms of business outcomes and measurable KPIs.
  • Knowledge of regulatory processes and market dynamics in the US is a plus.

What We Offer

  • $150,000-$200,000 base salary
  • Uncapped commission
  • Equity in a fast-growing climate tech startup
  • Remote-first culture with a growing presence in NYC
  • Health, dental, vision, and 401k.

title: Chief Product & Technology Officer
description:
About Nira Energy

  • Nira's mission is to help convert the US power grid to be 100% fossil-free.
  • We are profitable!
  • Nira is a software platform that helps renewable energy developers find the cheapest points on the grid to connect.
  • We focus on estimating the cost to interconnect with the electrical grid (aka the Interconnection Process). Depending on where developers connect, they may be on the hook to pay millions of dollars to upgrade power lines, substations etc.
About The Company
  • Our mission is to convert the US power grid to be 100% fossil-free and do our part in combating climate change
  • The electric grid is one of the largest bottlenecks standing between us and a clean energy future. Our software helps transmission engineers plan the grid in a faster, more economic, and more reliable manner
  • We are the market leader in tranmission software and are currently used by >100 of the most sophisticated engineering teams in the country
  • We are on a path to 5x’ing our revenue as we continue to rapidly scale with both our existing customers and into new markets
  • We’ve been profitable since inception and have a highly unique financial profile. We aren’t subject to the traditional VC funding cycles and are anticipating material liquidity events for equity owners in the company
  • This is a once in a lifetime opportunity to join a company that is positioned to have a massive impact on climate change, coupled with extremely high financial upside for the leaders that help bring these products to market

About The Role

This role will sit parallel to our co-founder and Chief Transmission Officer, Andrew, who is one of the foremost transmission planners in the industry. Andrew will be responsible for high level product vision and will serve as our SME on where the industry is heading.

The CPTO will be responsible for turning that vision into a sequenced roadmap and leading the team responsible for building those products.

The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning, and our Product Managers will report to the CPTO. For context, the Transmission Planning team works hand in hand with the software engineering team to write the code needed to generate our data. The organization is currently ~17 people with 2 Product Managers, 7 Software Engineers, and 8 Transmission Planners.

Ultimately, the CPTO will be the founders technical operating partner, responsible for translating customer insights into products as we scale to $50M+ ARR.

The ideal candidate is an executive with a strong track record of building high performing teams and world class products. You’ve ideally held a prominent role at an early stage startup, i.e <50 people and $10M in revenue, and can speak to successful product outcomes you’ve led in that capacity. You’ve also ideally held a prominent role at at a company that has scaled, i.e. 50-250 people and >$50M in revenue and can speak to successful product outcomes you’ve led there as well.

What you'll own

  • Delivery and execution: You're the single point of accountability for how the product and engineering organization performs against its weekly, quarterly, and annual goals
  • Product Decisions: You’ll partner with Andrew to set the product vision / roadmap direction and will ultimately be responsible for ensuring the team is making product decisions that increase revenue and retention
  • People Leadership: The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning and the Product Managers will report to you. You’ll be responsible for managing their growth and performance and getting the organization to work as one smooth efficient machine.
  • Operating Engine: You’ll be responsible for building the systems, processes and cadences to make product delivery predictable and efficient as we scale

What we're looking for

  • A proven track record of building a high performing product team and executive leadership. You have led one or multiple product organizations and former reports regard you as a A+ leader that they’d join again in a heartbeat
  • A proven track record of building successful products. You’ve led one or many product initiatives that have delivered material customer value and can speak competently to results; i.e. Built a product from $0 to >$10M in revenue, Improve retention of a product by 30%, scaled a product from $10M to $50M etc
  • You are willing to be hands on and get in the weeds. This is a ~17 person org and a 30 person company. While you are ultimately in charge of managing the team we expect you to be a hands on operator and willing to roll your sleeves up
  • Ability and interest in learning a highly niche, complex domain fast. Transmisison planning is incredibly intricate and becoming fluent in the language of “transmission” is critical to success in the role
  • Low ego and mission driven. Your energized by the mission of the company and by building a team, motivating them, and partnering with world class founders
  • Excellent communication and people leadership skills

Ideal backgrounds

  • VP Product / CPO at a technical B2B SaaS company.
  • GM of a complex technical product line.
  • A product leader who has run a team or product function end to end.
  • A former technical or product founder who scaled into executive leadership.
  • Bonus points for experience in energy, grid infrastructure, climate, utilities, transmission, interconnection, or power markets, but not required
